items.title: Anthropic example skills
items.summary: Thirteen everyday skills for design, art, writing, building apps and testing web pages, taken from Anthropic's public skills repository.
items.licenceNotes: Apache-2.0 per folder; canvas-design fonts are SIL OFL 1.1. brand-guidelines is left out (Q-SKILLS-4 A). skill-creator carries skills/skill-creator/LICENSE.txt.

items.title: Anthropic document skills
items.summary: Five skills for Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files plus a co-writing guide, from the same Anthropic repository, shown with their terms first.
items.licenceNotes: docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf: proprietary (source-available; use governed by the user's agreement with Anthropic; no copies outside Anthropic's services, no derivatives, no distribution). doc-coauthoring: no licence stated.

items.title: Anthropic knowledge-work plugins
items.summary: Eighteen plugin folders of role-based skills for sales, legal, finance, data and other office work, offered one folder at a time.
items.licenceNotes: Apache-2.0; partner plugins MIT (Apollo, brand-voice, Slack, Zoom) or Apache-2.0 (Common Room). Many name connectors nth does not provide; the text works without them.

items.title: Anthropic financial services
items.summary: A large bundle of finance skills from Anthropic's public financial-services repository.
items.licenceNotes: Apache-2.0. Connectors are named in the text.

items.title: Anthropic life sciences
items.summary: Six research skills from Anthropic's life-sciences repository, skill folders only.
items.licenceNotes: Apache-2.0 per folder. Science packages are named in the text.

items.title: Anthropic Claude Code plugins
items.summary: The Anthropic-written plugins from the claude-plugins-official repository, counted when the pin is re-read.
items.licenceNotes: Licence signals conflict for 11 of these plugins and claude-security is proprietary (skills-PLAN.md section 2); the set is treated as non-open until SK-2 reads each plugin's own licence.

items.title: Codex built-in skills
items.summary: Four skills Codex ships for images, OpenAI documentation, code review and writing skills, for providers other than Codex.
items.licenceNotes: Apache-2.0 (repository; folder files where present). skill-creator carries license.txt in its folder; review-agent has no licence file in its folder and is covered by the repository's root LICENSE. skill-installer is left out.

items.title: OpenAI curated skills
items.summary: Thirty skills for GitHub chores, notebooks, deployments and browser work, from OpenAI's curated skills folder.
items.licenceNotes: Apache-2.0; MIT for the 4 Notion skills (Notion Labs) and vercel-deploy (Vercel); the Playwright skills carry a Microsoft NOTICE. Without the 8 Figma folders, pdf and openai-docs; with skills/.system/plugin-creator.

items.title: OpenAI open document skills
items.summary: Four skills for Word, spreadsheet, slide and PDF work, each at its own pinned commit in OpenAI's skills history.
items.licenceNotes: Apache-2.0 per folder; the slides JavaScript helpers also say 'All rights reserved' and both notices are kept as published.

items.title: OpenAI plugins under MIT
items.summary: Nine OpenAI plugins for web building, charts, games, evaluation, Android testing and research, each under the MIT licence.
items.licenceNotes: MIT in each plugin.json (no licence text in the folders; a few skill folders carry Apache-2.0 files). plugin-eval fixtures are dropped.

items.title: OpenAI proprietary plugins
items.summary: Eight OpenAI plugins marked proprietary, shown with their terms before anything is downloaded.
items.licenceNotes: 'Proprietary' in plugin.json; public-equity-investing's licence file says internal use only. Needs vary per plugin and are set when SK-2 reads them.

items.title: Figma skills
items.summary: The eight Figma skill folders that sit in OpenAI's curated skills folder, shown under Figma's own developer terms.
items.licenceNotes: Figma Developer Terms (beta), not an open licence (skills-PLAN.md section 2). Figma still works through the providers' own sign-in (OD-0099 Q4). The folder names are read by SK-2.

items.title: Python
items.summary: The Python runtime nth's skills run their scripts with, in the small embeddable build.
items.licenceNotes: Bundles OpenSSL (Apache-2.0), libffi (MIT), SQLite (public domain) and others.

items.title: pip
items.summary: The package installer that sets up the Python package sets and the agent's own installs.

items.title: Node.js
items.summary: The JavaScript runtime with npm and npx, as the Windows zip.
items.licenceNotes: npm is Artistic-2.0; the user's own download, so no redistribution question.

items.title: LibreOffice
items.summary: The office suite nth drives headlessly to convert and render documents.
items.licenceNotes: With LGPL and other parts as LibreOffice ships them.

items.title: Poppler
items.summary: The PDF command-line tools for turning pages into images and text.
items.licenceNotes: No Windows build from the Poppler project; the conda-forge build as packaged by oschwartz10612/poppler-windows. The user's own download.

items.title: qpdf
items.summary: A small command-line tool for repairing, merging and encrypting PDFs.

items.title: pandoc
items.summary: A document converter used to pull text out of Word files.
items.licenceNotes: The user's own download.

items.title: Git for Windows
items.summary: A portable Git with Git Bash, so the shell scripts some skills carry can run.
items.licenceNotes: The user's own download.

items.title: GitHub CLI
items.summary: GitHub's command-line tool, for the skills that read and answer pull requests.
items.licenceNotes: Signing in stays the user's: gh auth login.

items.title: uv
items.summary: A fast Python package and project tool used by the notebook skill.
items.licenceNotes: Also offered under MIT: LICENSE-MIT at the same tag. The licence file kept here is LICENSE-APACHE.

items.title: Playwright Chromium
items.summary: The Chromium browser build Playwright pins, in its full and headless forms, for testing web pages.
items.licenceNotes: Chromium BSD-3 and the notices it ships. Revision 1243, the build playwright 1.63.0 pins.

items.title: Python: Office documents
items.summary: The Python libraries for reading and writing Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, with a converter to Markdown.
items.licenceName: MIT, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause and others
items.licenceNotes: Each package keeps its own licence (its .dist-info licence files); the licence file here is python-docx 1.2.0's, the set's lead package. Free-text licence metadata: beautifulsoup4, defusedxml, flatbuffers, markdownify, onnxruntime, protobuf. Download size is 5.3 MB plus markitdown and its dependencies (sized at SK-2).

packages.name: numpy
packages.licence: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0

items.title: Python: PDF
items.summary: The Python libraries for reading, building and checking PDF files.
items.licenceName: MIT, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, MIT-0 and others
items.licenceNotes: Each package keeps its own licence (its .dist-info licence files); the licence file here is pypdf 6.20.0's, the set's lead package. Free-text licence metadata: pdfplumber, pypdfium2, reportlab.

packages.name: reportlab
packages.licence: BSD license (see license.txt for details), Copyright (c) 2000-2025, ReportLab Inc.

items.title: Python: images and data
items.summary: The Python libraries for pictures, numbers, tables and charts.
items.licenceName: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, MIT-CMU and others
items.licenceNotes: Each package keeps its own licence (its .dist-info licence files); the licence file here is Pillow 12.3.0's, the set's lead package. cycler, kiwisolver, matplotlib, pandas state their licence as a full text in their metadata. Free-text licence metadata: cycler, kiwisolver, matplotlib, pandas, python-dateutil. With their dependencies (BSD, MIT, Matplotlib licence). Pillow's wheel carries a longer LICENSE that adds the licences of the libraries it bundles.

packages.name: numpy
packages.licence: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0

items.title: Python: browser testing
items.summary: The Python side of Playwright, used to drive a browser from a script.
items.licenceNotes: Each package keeps its own licence (its .dist-info licence files); the licence file here is playwright 1.63.0's, the set's lead package. The browser itself is T10.

items.title: Python: GIF making
items.summary: The Python libraries for building animated GIFs.
items.licenceNotes: Each package keeps its own licence (its .dist-info licence files); the licence file here is imageio 2.38.1's, the set's lead package. imageio-ffmpeg carries an FFmpeg binary (GPL), the user's own download.

packages.name: numpy
packages.licence: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0

items.title: Node: document packages
items.summary: The JavaScript libraries for building Word and PowerPoint files and for image work.
items.licenceNotes: Each package keeps its own licence (its package.json and files); the licence file here is docx 9.10.0's, the set's lead package. About 129 MB unpacked (react-icons alone 88 MB); the npm tarballs are sized at SK-2.
